s: Adenosine, a chemical byproduct of cellular energy use (ATP), accumulates during wakefulness and signals sleep pressure. Sleep clears adenosine, restoring alertness. Caffeine blocks adenosine's effects, impacting next-day energy if timed poorly.
sub: Adenosine's role in sleep regulation and sleep pressure.
